title: El alquiler
desc: A house, a price, and a handshake instead of a contract
setting: You are standing in the patio of a small house three blocks away, and don Beto has come with you.

steps.speaker: Dueño
steps.es: Cuatro mil al mes, sin el agua.
steps.en: Four thousand a month, not counting the water.

options.es: ¿Y la luz? ¿Esa también la pago yo?
options.en: And the electricity? Do I pay that too?
options.feedback: Ask about every service one by one before you agree a number. What is and is not included decides what four thousand actually costs you.
You have agreed to a number you do not yet understand. Don Beto is looking at the roof and saying nothing.

options.en: That is a lot for this house.
options.feedback: That is don Beto's line to say, not yours. He came precisely so that the foreigner would not have to.

steps.speaker: Don Beto
steps.es: Está caro para este barrio, don. Tres mil quinientos.
steps.en: That is dear for this neighbourhood, don. Three thousand five hundred.

options.es: Yo confío en lo que diga don Beto.
options.en: I trust whatever don Beto says.
options.feedback: Let him do it. He knows the barrio prices, the landlord knows he knows, and neither of them wants you in the middle of it.

options.es: Tres mil quinientos me parece justo.
options.en: Three thousand five hundred seems fair to me.
options.feedback: You backed him up, which is harmless. The strongest thing you can do here is stay quiet.

options.es: Yo puedo pagar los cuatro mil.
options.en: I can pay the four thousand.
options.feedback: You have just undone the man who came here for you, in front of him. That will be remembered longer than the money.

steps.speaker: Dueño
steps.es: Tres mil ochocientos y hay trato. Un mes de depósito.
steps.en: Three thousand eight hundred and we have a deal. One month deposit.

options.es: ¿El depósito me lo devuelve al final?
options.en: Do I get the deposit back at the end?
options.feedback: Ask it now, out loud, with a witness standing next to you. That is what a witness is for when there is no paper.

options.en: Right then, three thousand eight hundred.
options.feedback: Agreed. The deposit is a month of your money and you did not ask a single question about it.
You can ask, and often there is none. Around here the handshake and the neighbour standing beside you do that job.

steps.speaker: Dueño
steps.es: Se lo devuelvo si deja la casa como está. ¿Estamos?
steps.en: You get it back if you leave the house as it is. Are we agreed?

options.feedback: Estamos closes it, and you shake his hand on it. That handshake is the contract and everyone in the patio treats it as one.
Agreed, and flat. Estamos is the word that answers the question he actually asked.

options.en: We will think about it and I will let you know.
options.feedback: Don Beto has just spent his own standing getting you a price. Walking away now spends it for nothing.
